name: usage-meter
description: Token, cost, context and rate-limit meter: a status entry, a band above the prompt, a pane (Overview, Models, Agents, Diagnostics) and threshold toasts. Reads usage numbers only. Sends nothing out and stores nothing on disk.

costAlertUsd.title: Session cost alert (USD)
costAlertUsd.description: A toast shows each time the session's estimated cost passes another multiple of this amount. 0 turns the cost alert off.
